content.short: OpenBB Terminal is a Python terminal that infuses data science and machine learning into trading research.
content.description: OpenBB Terminal is a community-driven, open-source trading research tool that is free for the public to use. Retail and institutional traders can rely on the AI behind OpenBB Terminal to inform their investment decisions with data-driven insights. Developers can contribute code and content through the OpenBB SDK, helping to extend the platform's capabilities and enhance the project's effectiveness for a broad user community. The platform is designed to support collaboration among researchers, traders, and developers.
